text: Bitcoin is recovering modestly at $60,258 while Ethereum is outpacing it with a stronger 5% gain, suggesting selective risk appetite toward altcoins despite extreme fear conditions. The Fear & Greed index at 12 reflects capitulation rather than capitulation reversal—holders are still panicked, though the flat 7-day trend indicates sentiment may be stabilizing. Bitcoin's 57.9% dominance and $124B in 24h volume point to cautious positioning: money is rotating into alts like Ethereum and Solana, but total market conviction remains low.
